title: H3 base candidates: Singularity H3 and FastH3 Trim vs ours (replace or add), their upscalers, draft resolution
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-1179 - New Models to Test. Menu: tasks/MPI-1179/plan.md. Moved under the New Models to Test umbrella (Fabio 2026-10-18). Story (MPI-1134) still waits on it.

Research. Fabio 2026-10-13: the Singularity build of MiniMax H3 is what people use now (better fast motion, less tearing, trained for fights). Bench it vs our H3 base, try the upscalers from the video where Fabio found it, and pick the Story draft resolution (1344x768 may be too high). Blocks Story and Infinite Video - see docs/story/roadmap.md.

Fabio 2026-10-18: FastH3 Trim (FastVideo, 42-block pruned 8-step H3) joins as a second candidate. Test both vs what we ship, then replace ours or add one as a separate model. Brief: tasks/MPI-1135/brief.md. Step 0 (Fabio 2026-10-18): compare no upscale / ours / Benji's MMH3 Ultimate Upscale + LMS LoRA first, plus Veda sparse attention for speed.
